user.title: SmartGrade Secure login
user.description: Enter the phone number registered in the SmartGrade Secure app (for example 05XXXXXXXX). An SMS code will be sent to it.

data_description.mobile: The same number you use to log in to the SmartGrade Secure app.

code.title: SMS code
code.description: Enter the code that was sent by SMS to {mobile}.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate SmartGrade
reauth_confirm.description: The SmartGrade login expires every 30 days. Submit to send a new SMS code to {mobile}.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the SmartGrade cloud.
error.invalid_mobile: The SmartGrade cloud rejected this phone number.
error.invalid_code: The SMS code is wrong or has expired.

abort.wrong_account: This phone number belongs to a different SmartGrade account than the one being re-authenticated.

token_expired.message: The SmartGrade login has expired (it is valid for 30 days). Re-authenticate with a new SMS code.

update_failed.message: Error communicating with the SmartGrade cloud: {error}
